name: hud_stack_call_alone_beside_caretakers
description: A call waits only for partners who are present (M8's review; design 2.7 and 5.7; SimWaves._all_ready counts a caretaken seat as Ready): beside a caretaker partner (offline company) and beside a teammate who left, my hollow has seats but no other player on it, so the horn's tooltip says the called wave sets out at once, not once everyone has called it, and the strip adds no '· Ready n/m' while the call goes out (Game.has_company asks for another present seat of my hollow, not for another seat). Beside a present partner the tooltip still says the call waits for everyone.

steps.assert: scene.sim.hollows[0].seats.size() == 2 and not Game.has_company() and Game.can_stack()
steps.msg: two seats on my hollow, the other caretaken: no company

steps.assert: tip.begins_with('Call wave 2 now: ') and tip.contains('It sets out at once, among the creeps on the road.') and not tip.contains('everyone')
steps.msg: the tooltip says the call sets out at once
the strip counts no Ready while the call goes out
the caretaker counted as Ready: wave 2 set out as the call landed

steps.assert: tip_partner.contains('It sets out once everyone has called it')
steps.msg: beside a present partner the call waits for everyone

steps.assert: tip_left.contains('It sets out at once, among the creeps on the road.') and not tip_left.contains('everyone')
steps.msg: with the partner gone the call sets out at once
